name: dev.octri/mcp
title: Octri API Docs
description: Search an Octri project's API docs and call its endpoints as tools, shaped by its SDK Studio config.

environmentVariables.name: OCTRI_PROJECT_ID
environmentVariables.description: The Octri project whose docs and endpoints this server exposes.

environmentVariables.name: OCTRI_API_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL for endpoint calls. Defaults to the Base URL set in the project's SDK Studio.

environmentVariables.name: OCTRI_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer or OAuth2 token for the documented API, not for Octri.

environmentVariables.name: OCTRI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the documented API, not for Octri. Sent in the OCTRI_API_KEY_HEADER header.

environmentVariables.name: OCTRI_API_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Basic-auth username for the documented API.

environmentVariables.name: OCTRI_API_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Basic-auth password for the documented API.
